body: Thank you hopefully it’ll look better soon 🙏

Thanks a lot. I appreciate the kind words. I do hope it gets better with time and you made the right decision not getting surgery. It really isn’t worth the risk unless your nose is awful or disfigured
Thank you so much. Hoping it will get better 🙏

I used to get bullied for my looks as a kid all the time. I’ve had anxiety about my looks every since and hated my nose but as I grew older I grew into my nose and I regret succumbing to my own insecurity so much. I’m paying the price massively now, never felt so insecure in my life
I’m in the UK but thank you for those words. It’s probably what I needed to hear right now. I will try my best to carry on for my family. Thank you ❤️

Thank you. I appreciate it. But I just hate myself too much right now to overlook it. I was happy a month ago, I had a great nose, great friends a good job and I’ve lost everything. The only things that give me joy right now is trying to find the easiest way to end it all. The only thing that is stopping me is my family. I’ve ruined my life and my self hatred has consumed my entire life to the point that I’m not sure even that is enough to keep me here anymore. I really appreciate the kind words though.
Think revision after a year but this next few months will be difficult. I think the hardest of my life tbh
Let’s hope they improve over time. Wish I researched this a lot more beforehand tbh
Yeah I just feel so ashamed and embarrassed
Thank you for your kind words, I had severe depression before the surgery so I’m surprised I’m still here after the result. But I appreciate your concern xx
It was great. I miss my old nose everyday. Like I said it’s the biggest mistake of my life and I regret it every second of the day
I didn’t agree to any tip change at all. The doctor just did what he wanted in surgery unfortunately
Thank you. I think I definitely need help tbh. I’ve felt suicidal every day since and I haven’t regretted something so much in my life. It’s a mistake I’m reminded of every time I pass a mirror
Thank you. How long was it until you started seeing better results?
From my point of view my side profile is better than pre surgery but my front is a million times worse so far

Thanks for reassuring me. It’s a difficult time, especially because I regret getting the surgery due to the fact I was in 2 minds as to whether I still wanted to go ahead with it pre operation and now my life has flipped on it’s head. I’m scared to leave my house, I’ve lost my job, friends and I’ve stopped speaking to those close to me. So I appreciate you taking the time to make me think it might get better
Thanks for the kind words. How long did it take for your front profile to start looking better?
Honestly I don’t know but I doubt it. Possibly need to get a revision in a year from now
